Who is Pedrinho Guerreiro?

I am Ana Cristina, Pedrinho's mother, and we live in the countryside of Mato Grosso. Every day, my son battles a rare disease that causes painful wounds all over his body.

Every new wound means more pain. Each flare-up requires care that I can't manage on my own.

The treatments and supplies Pedrinho needs already cost more than $7,900 a month.

Please help us keep fighting. Your donation can give my son a day with less pain.

What does he need?

Wound care twice a day

With his weakened immune system, open wounds can become infected. Dressings help them heal and can cost more than $5,600 a month.

Medications, ointments, and creams

They help prevent infections, reduce inflammation, and manage the constant pain that often keeps him from sleeping.

Appointments and hospital stays

In addition to routine tests, hospital stays are becoming more frequent because of his condition.

Supplements and therapeutic diet

Because his immune system is weakened, he needs a special diet to build strength.

Frequently asked questions

Find answers to your questions about the campaign and SOS Human Help.

What condition does Pedrinho have?

He has dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (DEB), a rare genetic condition that causes blisters and lesions. Even slight friction can cause painful wounds.

What is SOS Human Help?

It is a Brazilian organization that supports people facing financial and health-related hardship.

Is my donation secure?

Yes. Payments are processed through UniversePay's secure checkout.

How can I follow the impact?

Updates are shared through SOS Human Help's official channels.
